# Ground-truth system for the algebraic-AVR parity test: a SynchronousSubtransientSP
# machine driven by AVRKundur_Filter with a SMALL parasitic filter time constant
# (Tfd). As Tfd -> 0 this filtered exciter (Efd a differential state) converges to
# the avr_leadlag system, where Efd is the lead-lag's ALGEBRAIC output. Topology
# mirrors the 3_bus / sp_ground fixtures. See docs/algebraic_equations_design.md.
